meta_description: look look!! i built a review robot!! for your pull requests!! hakase's lab ✿
session_expired: github ran away. come in again!! (；′⌒`)
lab_hero_tagline: look look!! i built a review robot!! for your pull requests!!
lab_hero_intro: come in with github!! i show you secrets!! brains!! then robot jumps on a repo and writes on the lines!! suggestion blocks even!! hehe isn't that cool?? robots are cute. (◕‿◕✿)
lab_hero_how_intro: it's easy!! you stick a brain in a box. you give robot a house on github. then robot waits in your repo until a pull request moves!!
lab_hero_step_signin_body: github knows you. i need that.
lab_hero_step_secrets_body: a {loginEngine} login. a {keyEngine} key. whatever brain you like!! i lock them with a key only your browser knows. i don't peek. promise!!
lab_hero_step_brain_body: which robot thinks?? how hard?? drag them around. top one goes first!!
lab_hero_step_house_body: a tiny public repo on your account. robot sleeps there. your real repos don't run it. smart!! isn't it??
lab_hero_step_let_in_body: install the helper on a repo. copy the key to the house. then when someone opens a pull request the helper pokes the lab and robot wakes up!!
lab_hero_step_lines_body: robot reads the diff and posts a real github review. comments on the lines!! suggestion blocks!! hehe.
lab_hero_more_after: sharks are in there too. maybe.
about_intro: hehe this is my invention!! look look!! (｀・ω・´) i built a robot that wakes up on your pull requests and writes real reviews. little comments on the lines!! suggestion blocks!! come to the lab i'll show you what to paste. easy!! robots are cute.
about_pr_body_1: someone opens a pull request. or they poke robot {poke}. the helper tells the lab. the lab pokes robot in your house. the house runs on github actions so your company repo doesn't spend minutes on robot. hehe smart!!
about_pr_body_2: robot wakes a coding brain. it reads the diff and your review notes. then it posts a native github review on the pull request. line comments!! suggestion blocks!! a little comment on the pull request too!! isn't that cool??
about_house_body: i don't hide secrets inside your big important repo. i make a little public house on your github. actions secrets live there. the helper bot watches your real repo and posts reviews as itself. you still own everything!! the house just holds stuff for robot. because it's cute.
about_key_heading: the key and the secret boxes!!
about_key_body: when you sign in i make a key in your browser. once. i never see it again. you paste brain logins in the lab and i lock them with that key. later your browser copies them into the house as github actions secrets. lose the key and the boxes stay locked forever. write it down write it down!!
about_on_intro: do these and robot can play!! each one hops to the right tab in the lab. hehe.
about_on_secret_body: stick a brain's login in a box. i lock it with your key.
about_on_brain_body: which robot thinks?? how hard?? drag them around.
about_on_house_body: a public github repo on your account. robot lives there!!
about_on_let_in_body: helper first. then copy the key to the house. then robot writes on the lines!!
about_on_key_body: write it down before you close the window. please please!!
about_wake_body: by default robot looks at new pull requests on the default branch. you can say only when someone mentions robot. you can say only your friends' pull requests. you can tell robot what to care about in review notes. skip the changelog if you want!! easy!!
about_brains_body: {engines}!! most want a login cookie. {antigravity} keeps oauth in the OS keyring after you sign into `agy`. there is no `agy auth login`. secret-tool will refuse it on kde, so dump with python libsecret. because it's cute. (¬‿¬) sharks are cute too. hehe.
ceremony_body: your browser made this. i can't peek!! lose it and the boxes stay locked forever. write it down write it down!! (´；ω；｀)
ceremony_saved_tick: i wrote it down. somewhere safe!!
ceremony_enter: i have the key. let me in!! (◕‿◕✿)
import_body: this browser has no key. the boxes are already here. paste the one you wrote!! a fake one won't work. no way!!
import_lost_intro: this throws the locked logins away and makes a new key. you paste secrets again. only if the old key is gone!!
import_no_sample: no locked box to try this key on (・ω・)
import_key_mismatch: that key can't open a sealed box. no way!! (｀ω´)
lab_not_loaded: the lab isn't loaded yet (・ω・)
onboarding_intro: tap. hop to the tab. easy!!
onboarding_secret_blurb: a brain login. i lock it.
onboarding_brain_blurb: which one thinks?? drag. top goes first.
onboarding_house_blurb: tiny public repo. robot sleeps there.
onboarding_let_in_blurb: helper first. then copy the key. then it writes on the lines!!
accounts_intro: log in or paste. i lock it. the lab never sees it. if it's wrong robot yells later. not now. (¬‿¬)

erase_warning: i throw away everything in the lab!! github keeps the house, the helper, and old review comments. after this: delete (or empty) the house on github, uninstall the helper if you don't want it, and revoke the helper's permission to act as you (github → settings → applications). okay?? this can't be undone. (´；ω；｀)
